Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a business and occupation tax deduction for amounts received with respect to child welfare services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a business and occupation tax deduction foramounts received with respect to child welfare services; adding a newsection to chapter 82.04 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A health or social welfare organization may deduct from themeasure of tax amounts received as compensation for providing childwelfare services under a governmentfunded program. (2) A person may deduct from the measure of tax amounts receivedfrom the state of Washington for distribution to a health or socialwelfare organization that is eligible to deduct the distribution undersubsection (1) of this section. (3) The following definitions apply to this section: (a) "Child welfare services" has the same meaning as provided inRCW 74.13.020; and (b) "Health or social welfare organization" has the meaningprovided in RCW 82.04.431.
This act applies to amounts received by ataxpayer on or after August 1, 2011.
